cohort: The study included 603 children aged 5 to 18 years in the Al Baha region, with a mean age of 9.1 years and a male predominance.
finding: The prevalence of nocturnal enuresis was 35.0% among children aged 5-18 years, and it was significantly associated with mode of delivery and prematurity.
mod_finding: A significant association was found between nocturnal enuresis and mode of delivery (p=0.027).
cross-section timing: Data was collected for children aged 5 to 18 years at the time of the study.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured, with prematurity (birth before seven months of gestation) showing a significant relationship with nocturnal enuresis.
